canonical_data: agent, tool, and knowledge-base definitions with conversation threads and execution traces
strengths: Registers external agents by typed provider across six integrations, including another vendor's customer-relationship agents and a competitor's low-code agents
Documented air-gapped on-premises operation with a release-by-release compatibility matrix and a local package-registry procedure
Model-neutral through a gateway spanning fourteen providers, including self-hosted options
weaknesses: The open component is the client: the runtime that plans, routes, and selects collaborators is proprietary, so routing behavior can be observed through vendor traces but never read
The vendor's own known-issues list documents tools running before required inputs arrive, repeated identical tool calls, and failed agent-to-agent transfers
The local Developer Edition is licensed to a single developer, cannot deploy, and still routes inputs and outputs through the vendor's cloud
why_it_matters: One of the few systems that puts agents from several vendors behind one registry, one policy layer, and one trace log, including on hardware the customer owns.
